page.intro_headline: Find the style that moves you.
page.intro_text: From foundational technique to high-energy performance, AIM offers a variety of dance styles designed to help dancers grow in confidence, artistry and ability.
page.hero_text: Explore the styles offered at Art In Motion Dance Center and discover the training that inspires your dancer.

genres.name: Ballet & Pointe
genres.card_description: Build strength, alignment, flexibility and classical technique through structured ballet and pointe training.
genres.page_description: Build strength, alignment, flexibility and classical technique through structured ballet training.
genres.note: Pointe registration is only available to our more advanced dancers with studio approval necessary in order to keep our dancers safe.

genres.name: Jazz
genres.card_description: High-energy movement focused on musicality, turns, jumps, flexibility and performance quality.
genres.page_description: High-energy movement focused on musicality, turns, jumps, flexibility and performance quality.

genres.name: Tap
genres.card_description: Develop rhythm, musicality and precise footwork while learning to create movement through sound.
genres.page_description: Develop rhythm, musicality and precise footwork while learning to create movement through sound.

genres.name: Lyrical
genres.card_description: A blend of ballet and jazz that combines technique, fluid movement and emotional storytelling.
genres.page_description: A blend of ballet and jazz that combines technique, fluid movement and emotional storytelling.

genres.name: Contemporary
genres.card_description: Explore expressive movement, musicality, floor work and dynamic technique in a creative environment.
genres.page_description: Explore expressive movement, musicality, floor work and dynamic technique in a creative environment.

genres.name: Hip Hop
genres.card_description: Energetic movement incorporating rhythm, grooves, musicality and current street-dance influences.
genres.page_description: Energetic movement incorporating rhythm, grooves, musicality and current street-dance influences.

genres.name: Acro
genres.card_description: Combine dance technique with flexibility, strength, balance and controlled acrobatic skills.
genres.page_description: Combine dance technique with flexibility, strength, balance and controlled acrobatic skills.

genres.name: Jumps & Turns
genres.card_description: Focused technique training designed to strengthen jumps, turns, control, alignment and performance consistency.
genres.page_description: Focused technique training designed to strengthen jumps, turns, control, alignment and performance consistency.
genres.note: Mandatory for company dancers. Also available to recreational students upon request.
